purpose: Get a first agent user from zero to safe AgentPress install + MCP snippet + proof capture in one pack.

first_run_workflow.user_goal: Install safely, connect MCP by paste, verify locally, and leave shareable proof.
first_run_workflow.agent_prompt: Use AgentPress to inspect the available entrypoints, run doctor, then create a proof bundle for this first run. Do not post externally or mutate MCP config without explicit human approval.
success_looks_like: doctor returns JSON without fatal findings
MCP config was backed up before changes
host reloads with an AgentPress server entry
if_blocked: run package-registry-doctor with the install error
use generic platform when host-specific path is unknown
do not retry by disabling approval or secret guards

agent_affordances.name: proof_capture
agent_affordances.why: turns a first run into reviewable evidence

agent_affordances.name: sandbox_guard
agent_affordances.why: lets a user hand an agent a bounded workspace before exploration

agent_affordances.name: handoff_pack
agent_affordances.why: lets one agent transfer context without losing constraints
agent_affordances.command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py handoff-pack --from current --to next --task first-run --json

acceptance_gates: MCP snippet is paste-only, not auto-applied
